suggested.hi: मानता है / आदर देता है, मान करता है

reason: ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੈ (he honours what he has made) and a06.p2 ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ (everyone honours you) need the sense 'honours'.
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ and a02.p5 ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ are read as the Naam having its abode in the mind; the same sense applies to ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ.

suggested.en: touches, strikes; seems / engages in, takes up

reason: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ: let him take up the service of the holy.
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ is 'O foolish mind' (adjective in address), not a plural noun.

problem: ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ: current half a word | आधा अक्षर; the Hindi and the line mean half a letter, half a syllable.
fix: ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ: आधा अक्षर | half a word / half a letter, half a syllable

problem: ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ: the Hindi gives सिंह, the English lacks it; Skt mṛgāśana, deer-eater = lion (Monier-Williams).
fix: ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ: मृग खानेवाले (सिंह) | tigers, predators / lions (deer-eaters)

problem: ਬਨਿ: English has only becoming; in ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ (a07.p3) and ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ (a07.p8) the line needs befitting / a bond formed (the Hindi फबकर has it).
fix: ਬਨਿ: बनकर, फबकर / (बनि आई) मेल बन गया | becoming / befitting, suiting; (with ਆਈ) has come to suit, a bond has formed

reason: Prof. Sahib Singh reads ਰਸੈ in ਸਾਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸੈ as ਰਸਨਾ ਤੋਂ (from the tongue); add that sense.
In ਤੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ it is set against honour, so the line needs the sense of scorn received (our Hindi: अपमान).
In ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ the word is commonly read as the created world, with ਕਾਰਣ its cause.
In ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭਲਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ it refers to the self-praising man, not to God; the capitalised Him misleads.
In ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ the word means renown; that sense is missing.

suggested.hi: पाता है / (पाछै पावै) पीछे पड़ता है

reason: ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ means he runs after Maya, not obtains it.

suggested.hi: धारण करता है / टिकाये रखता है

reason: In ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਧਾਰੈ God holds creation on his thread; enshrines does not fit.
The literal sense (rot, waste away) is wanted alongside the figurative one.
Enticing suggests temptation; ਮਨੋਹਰ ਬੈਨ in the Saadh's company are pleasing, charming words.
In ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤੁ (and a12.p4 ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ) the word is the pronoun I; that sense is missing.

suggested.en: virtues, praises / qualities (the three gunas of Maya)

reason: In ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ the word is the three gunas, not virtues or praises.

suggested.en: listen / I listen, may I hear

reason: The Hindi already gives the first-person सुनूँ; the English lacks it, and the -ਉ form is first person here.
Parallel to ਸੁਨਉ in the same stanza, which continues in the first person (ਭਏ, ਹਮਾਰੀ); add the first-person sense.

problem: ਉਝੜਿ: English gloss has only 'into desolation'; the line needs the sense the Hindi already gives (कुमार्गपर): off the path, astray.
fix: ਉਝੜਿ: कुमार्गपर, उजाड़में | into desolation / off the path, astray

reason: In ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ the word is singular: the slanderer's own place or station.

suggested.hi: टेढ़ा होता है / फिर जाता है

reason: ਭਵਣਾ is to turn; the line can be read as the face being turned away.
Possibly from Sanskrit tiṣṭhati (stands); see doubts file a13.p7.
ਹੋਵਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ = become fortunate (our Hindi: भाग्यवान बनो); elsewhere in the batch it is the Lord.

suggested.en: in places / to its place, at rest

reason: ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ = (the wandering mind) comes back to its place, to rest.

current: भाई; हे भाई | brother; O sibling

suggested.hi: भाई; हे भाई / भायी, अच्छी लगी
suggested.en: brother; O sibling / pleased, was pleasing

reason: ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ = the telling is pleasing to the mind (verb from ਭਾਉਣਾ), not 'brother'.
ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ = he himself in turn meditates (on himself): present, third person, not imperative.
ਬਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ = in forest, grass and mountain (locative of ਬਨੁ).

suggested.en: he (did), that one / in the grass, in a blade of grass

reason: ਬਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ: ਤਿਨਿ is the locative of ਤਿਣੁ (grass), not the pronoun.

suggested.en: merge, be absorbed / is absorbed, blended

reason: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ describes God (he is blended with his creation), not a command.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ = that person becomes a treasure (singular, predicate).
